items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He and Vincent La Presto in Italian... They were in partnership.

ctx.x: Yeah, and hired me back. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He hired me back. I didn't care. I go right next door, go to the job. Get a job. You never have one right, I get a job.
He and Vincent La Presto in Italian. No, no, no, that's a serial. Serial, I meant to say. That's a serial. They were in partnership. They were in partnership. It was partnership.
